conventions.off: (fwd, side) in R from the CoM: fwd along the frame, side to its right as seen (board y down)
conventions.frame: 'vel' = heading (core.js slowHeading, Upward on), 'axis' = B->G body axis
conventions.turn: degrees, + clockwise as seen (right), measured once the name box names it again (at least 30 steps after the hold), against an untouched copy from the same start
conventions.spot: centre, or a direction (front, front-right, ... in the frame) on the body (0.45 R) or at its edge (0.9 R)
conventions.phase: steps since the main peak of the total mass in its cycle (0 .. period - 1), when the action starts
conventions.p: share of the start phases and angles with this outcome

composites.name: lithos activates
composites.steps: into tardus; into gyrans x2; into rectus x2

composites.name: paragyrans turns via antigyrans
composites.steps: into antigyrans; wait {w}; into paragyrans x2

composites.name: pararectus becomes paragyrans
composites.steps: into rectogyrans x2; into paragyrans x2
composites.note: step by step to the more maneuverable twin

composites.name: rectogyrans turns via antigyrans
composites.steps: into antigyrans; wait {w}; into paragyrans x2
composites.note: turn a twin, ending as the more maneuverable paragyrans

composites.name: rectus deactivates
composites.steps: into gyrans; into tardus x2; into lithos x3

composites.name: rectus turns via gyrans
composites.steps: into gyrans; wait {w}; into rectus x2
composites.note: turn (rectus cannot turn itself): the wait sets the angle
